rules.title: How credits are spent
rules.meterBody: Images are per picture, video is per second, and chat is per thousand tokens. A submit costs unit price × quantity × multiplier. The image count on a plan spends the whole month at {{credits}} credits per {{model}} image. Other models and video produce fewer images. The estimate is shown before you submit.
rules.meterBodyGeneric: Images are per picture, video is per second, and chat is per thousand tokens. A submit costs unit price × quantity × multiplier. The estimate is shown before you submit.
rules.bucketBody: Plan credits arrive each month and expire at month end. Top-up credits last. Packs are ¥{{amounts}}, at {{rate}} credits per yuan, with or without a plan. Plan credits are spent first.
rules.cycleBody: Monthly, quarterly, and yearly plans are a single payment and do not renew. Quarterly and yearly plans do not drop every month of credits in at once. Each entitlement month still grants that month’s amount.
rules.failureBody: If a job is cancelled or fails before delivery, the hold goes back to the bucket it came from. Retrying that same job does not hold credits again.
rules.inviteBody: When a friend signs up with your invite, each of you receives {{n}} credits in the long-lived balance. Later payments earn the inviter {{percent}}% of the amount paid, converted at {{rewardRate}} credits per yuan. That reward sits in a reward balance until you move it. It cannot be withdrawn as cash.
rules.inviteBodyUneven: When a friend signs up with your invite, you receive {{inviter}} credits and they receive {{invitee}}, in the long-lived balance. Later payments earn the inviter {{percent}}% of the amount paid, converted at {{rewardRate}} credits per yuan. That reward sits in a reward balance until you move it. It cannot be withdrawn as cash.

faq.title: Questions
faq.lead: Grants, expiry, spend order, top-ups, and invites.
faq.grantA: The first month arrives when you buy. Quarterly and yearly plans are paid once, but credits still arrive one month at a time.
faq.rolloverA: Plan credits do not. They clear at month end. Top-up credits stay, including after a plan ends.
faq.orderA: This month’s plan credits, then top-up credits.
faq.failureQ: Am I charged if generation fails?
faq.failureA: No. Failure and cancellation return the hold to the original bucket. A retry of that job does not hold credits again.
faq.unitQ: How many credits is one image?
faq.unitA: It depends on the model. {{model}} is listed at {{credits}} credits per image. Video is per second and chat is per token. The estimate before submit is the charge.
faq.unitAGeneric: It depends on the model. Video is per second and chat is per token. The estimate before submit is the charge.
faq.estimateQ: Where do the image counts come from?
faq.estimateA: The month’s credits divided by {{credits}}, the {{model}} price. That is a ceiling, not a promise. Other image models, video, and chat produce fewer images.
faq.estimateAGeneric: The image count divides the month’s credits by the current image price. That is a ceiling, not a promise. Other models, video, and chat produce fewer images.
faq.rechargeQ: Can I top up without a plan?
faq.rechargeA: Yes. Packs are ¥{{amounts}}, at {{rate}} credits per yuan. They last, and a plan is not required.
faq.renewA: No. Monthly, quarterly, and yearly plans are a single payment. When the term ends, grants stop. The next term is not charged.
faq.inviteQ: Can invite credits be spent or cashed out?
faq.inviteA: Signup rewards can be spent. Rewards from a friend’s payment sit in the reward balance until you move them into top-up credits. They are not cash and cannot be given to someone else.

close.title: Start with one image
close.body: You can top up credits without a plan. After you subscribe, plan credits arrive each month.
